v0.0.4.description:
# v0.0.4
## Changes
- Added Pistol as a necessary weapon in Target Missions - Step 1: Office Raid
- (Removed until 0.6.8) Goal is included in the apworld (useful for trackers I think)

## New Yaml Options!!!:
- Amount of medals needed to goal
- Types of medals to be used as checks (bronze,silver,gold,platinum,developer)
- Amount of Arcade levels to be included
- True/False send out lower medals when completing level
- Minimum Medals. If you set each medal to a random chance to be included this will make sure no less than this number will be rolled

## More Info
Seems to have an issue with Universal Tracker. Not sure if that is just me or if the apworld doesn't work well with it

Compatible with v0.0.4 Client
Client: https://github.com/Marsavue/DuckGameArchipelago/releases

# v0.1.0 Angel tear drop
New [PopTracker](https://github.com/blakelmenakle/Duck-Game-Poptracker/releases/latest) Thanks to Blakel
New APWorld rules Thanks to 1e1001
## Changes
- Added Death Link
- Death Link Amnesty
- 13 New Traps + 2 Anti-Traps
- Traps (more info in yaml):
  - Clumsy
  - Stop Hitting Yourself
  - FIREEE!
  - FIREEE*
  - Slippery Hands
  - Whats Under There?
  - Caught You!
  - Duck Season
  - Hot Potato
  - Whats This?
  - esreveR
  - A Gift for you
  - Don't look up
  - Prot V
  - Make it rain
- Mace Collar & Weight Ball is now a single item called Mace

## APWorld Changes
- Reworked logic so now each medal has requirements for certain items, should enhance randomisation
- Death Link setting
- Death Link Amnesty setting
- Goal condition is reimplemented and Universal tracker now works correctly
- Each trap can be weighted in the yaml

## More Info

Compatible with v0.1.0 Client
